punchline: In a 2001 study, reciting the Ave Maria slowed breathing to about six breaths a minute.
thirty_sec: In an Italian study, 23 healthy adults recited the Ave Maria and a yoga mantra. Both slowed their breathing to about six breaths a minute and increased variability in heart and blood-pressure rhythms. James Nestor's slow pace is 5.5 seconds in and 5.5 out.
